name: docket
description: A pane listing what Claude has said in prose is yours to decide or do (not AskUserQuestion); each item drops off when you decide or act, Claude reports it done, or you dismiss it.

model.title: Judge model
model.description: The model that reads each turn for asks and answers. One call after each turn and one per reply while items are open, about 2-8k tokens each: under a cent on haiku, a few cents on opus.
